Capabilities

What we build

From the frame that carries a roof to the staircase that carries a room's whole character — one workshop, one standard of finish.

01 / STRUCTURE

Structural Steel Frames

Primary and secondary steel frames engineered and erected for roofs, mezzanines, and long‑span buildings.

02 / ROOFING

Roof Structures & Canopies

Carports, walkways, and shade structures fabricated off‑site and installed to a tight, weatherproof tolerance.

03 / FINISH

Stainless Steel Cladding

Columns, counters, and custom fittings clad and hand‑finished in brushed or mirror stainless steel.

04 / SCULPTURE

Spiral & Sculptural Staircases

Helical and floating staircases engineered as load‑bearing structure, and detailed as a room's centrepiece.

05 / SAFETY

Railings & Balustrades

Glass, cable, and steel balustrades detailed to hold a line as clean as the drawing it came from.

How we work

From drawing to structure

Every piece we install has already existed twice — once as a drawing, once as a test fit in our workshop.

01

Design

Concept models and full working drawings, reviewed with you before a single piece of steel is cut.

02

Fabricate

Parts are cut, machined, and dimensioned to the millimetre in our own workshop, then test‑fitted before they reach site.

03

Install

Our own crews erect and finish on site — welding, grinding, and polishing to a standard that reads as furniture, not construction.
